description: Check the HelloFresh connection end to end: the ContextMint Bridge link to your signed-in www.hellofresh.com tab (which holds the session), the session token (minutes to expiry, and a warning if a refreshed session could not be written back to the browser), and a probe of the HelloFresh subscriptions endpoint that returns only its status. Call it when another hf_ tool fails, to learn which hop broke (bridge, sign-in, or HelloFresh itself).
name: hf_healthcheck
